title: 第13章 魔教魔使第14章 密信
slug: 锦衣卫开局手刃内奸上司
content_zh:
江辰的双眼如同寒星般闪烁，他冷冷地看着那人，嘴角勾起一抹嘲讽的笑意。
“忘记告诉你了，我最擅长的是拳脚。”
江辰的声音在冷风中显得格外清晰，他的嘴角勾起一抹冷冽的笑意，仿佛已经胜券在握。
随着话语落下，他一脚踢出，带着呼啸的风声，直取那人的腰部。
这一脚若是踢实，恐怕即便是钢筋铁骨也要被踢得骨折筋断。
那人脸色骤变，他没想到江辰竟然还有如此凌厉的肉身力量。
若是他再不弃剑，恐怕就要结结实实地挨上这一脚，后果不堪设想。
然而，若是他弃剑的话，又拿什么来和江辰斗呢？
毕竟，他手中的宝剑可是他最后的依仗。
这一刻，他陷入了深深的犹豫之中。
他的眼神在宝剑和江辰之间来回游移，内心充满了挣扎和矛盾。
他深知，自己一旦弃剑，就等于放弃了最后的希望。
但如果不弃剑，又难以抵挡江辰这凌厉的一击。
然而，就在这犹豫的一瞬间，江辰的攻势已经如影随形而至。
这一脚，那人选择了高高跃起，躲过这一击，并利用身体的惯性以及重心的转移来抽回被江辰双指夹住的宝剑。
他的眼中闪烁着决绝与不甘，仿佛要将全身的力量都凝聚在这一瞬间。
然而，他万万没想到的是，这一跃，却成了他陷入绝境的开始。
就在他的身体完全滞留在半空中的那一刻，江辰的眼中闪过一抹精光。
他敏锐地捕捉到了对手的破绽，心中大喜过望。
没有丝毫犹豫，他立即将手中的长剑往自己怀中一抽，利用这股力量，将半空中的对手整个带了过来。

那人只觉得一股强大的力量从宝剑上传来，他的身体不由自主地向前飞去，完全失去了控制。
他的心中充满了惊恐，他没想到江辰竟然会有如此强大的力量。
紧接着，江辰的另一只手如同闪电般伸出，猛地一把抓住了他的面门。
那一刻，他只感觉自己的脑袋像是被一只洪荒巨兽给紧紧捏住了一般，疼痛难忍，根本无法挣脱。
江辰的手劲之大，仿佛要将他的头颅生生捏碎。
他的眼中充满了惊恐与无助，他感受到了死亡的气息正在逼近。
他拼尽全力想要挣扎，但江辰的双手却如同铁钳一般牢固，让他丝毫动弹不得。
“砰！”
一声沉闷的巨响，江辰的动作干净利落，没有丝毫拖泥带水，直接将那人的脑袋狠狠地按进了院子的泥土之中。
尘土飞扬，泥土四溅，那人的脸瞬间被泥土覆盖，只留下一双惊恐而无助的眼睛，在泥土的缝隙中闪烁着微弱的光芒。
江辰的双眼如同寒星般闪烁，他的脸上没有丝毫的同情，只有冰冷的杀意。
他深吸一口气，随后便是一拳又一拳地砸在了那人的身上，每一拳都带着呼啸的风声和令人心悸的力量。
他的拳头如同雨点般密集而有力，每一次击打都让那人的身体剧烈地颤抖。
那人的眼中充满了惊恐，他感受到了江辰拳头的力量，仿佛要将他的身体彻底摧毁。
江辰的每一拳都精准地打在那人的要害之处，他的动作流畅而有力，颇有种武松打虎的气势。
在大概十来拳之后，那人的身体终于停止了颤抖，他彻底不动了。
content_en:
Jiang Chen's eyes flickered like cold stars. He looked at the man coldly, with a mocking smile on his lips.
"I forgot to tell you, what I am best at is boxing and kicking."
Jiang Chen's voice sounded particularly clear in the cold wind, and a cold smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, as if he already had a chance to win.
As he finished speaking, he kicked out, with a roaring wind, directly towards the man's waist.
If this kick is real, even the steel-reinforced bones will be kicked to pieces.
The man's expression suddenly changed. He didn't expect Jiang Chen to have such fierce physical strength.
If he didn't give up his sword, he would probably receive this kick, and the consequences would be disastrous.
However, if he gave up his sword, what would he use to fight Jiang Chen?
After all, the sword in his hand is his last resort.
At this moment, he fell into deep hesitation.
His eyes wandered back and forth between Baojian and Jiang Chen, and his heart was full of struggles and contradictions.
He knew very well that once he gave up his sword, he would be giving up his last hope.
But if he didn't abandon his sword, it would be difficult to withstand Jiang Chen's sharp blow.
However, at this moment of hesitation, Jiang Chen's offensive was already coming like a shadow.
With this kick, the man chose to jump high to avoid the blow, and used the inertia of his body and the shift of his center of gravity to withdraw the sword caught between Jiang Chen's fingers.
His eyes flashed with determination and unwillingness, as if he wanted to concentrate all his strength on this moment.
However, what he never expected was that this leap would become the beginning of his desperate situation.
At the moment when his body was completely stagnant in mid-air, Jiang Chen's eyes flashed with light.
He keenly caught his opponent's flaws and was overjoyed.
Without any hesitation, he immediately drew the long sword in his hand into his arms, and used this power to bring the entire opponent in mid-air.
The man felt a powerful force coming from the sword, and his body flew forward involuntarily, completely out of control.
His heart was filled with panic. He didn't expect Jiang Chen to have such a powerful power.
Immediately afterwards, Jiang Chen's other hand stretched out like lightning and suddenly grabbed his face.
At that moment, he felt as if his head was being squeezed tightly by a giant beast. The pain was unbearable and he could not break away at all.
Jiang Chen's hand was so strong that it seemed like he was going to crush his head to pieces.
His eyes were full of fear and helplessness, and he felt the breath of death approaching.
He tried his best to struggle, but Jiang Chen's hands were as firm as iron pliers, preventing him from moving at all.
"Bang!"
With a dull loud noise, Jiang Chen's movements were clean and neat, without any sloppiness, and he directly pressed the man's head into the dirt of the yard.
Dust was flying and mud was splashing everywhere. The man's face was instantly covered by mud, leaving only a pair of frightened and helpless eyes, shining faintly in the gaps in the mud.
Jiang Chen's eyes shone like cold stars, and there was no sympathy on his face, only cold murderous intent.
He took a deep breath, and then punched the man one after another, each punch carrying the sound of howling wind and heart-stopping power.
His fists were as dense and powerful as raindrops, and every blow made the man's body tremble violently.
The man's eyes were full of fear, and he felt the power of Jiang Chen's fist, as if it was going to completely destroy his body.
Each of Jiang Chen's punches hit that person's vital points accurately. His movements were smooth and powerful, giving him the aura of a martial artist fighting a tiger.
After about ten punches, the man's body finally stopped shaking and he was completely motionless.
